title: Mediterranean Escape Board
seo_title: Mediterranean Board for Two: Halloumi, Feta & Hummus (No Meat)
description: A meat-free Mediterranean board for two: grilled halloumi, feta, hummus, tzatziki, dolmas, Kalamata olives, cucumber, tomatoes, roasted peppers and warm pita.
hook: Sun-drenched and meat-free: a mezze board for two built around warm halloumi and dips.
why: Halloumi is the one cheese that's best hot: grilled, it turns golden outside and squeaky inside. Briny feta gives you a cold, salty contrast, and hummus and tzatziki give you two dips with very different textures.

Dolmas, Kalamata olives and roasted peppers add the savory notes that meat usually brings, and cucumber and tomatoes keep it fresh. Dried apricots or figs and pistachios finish it, with a Greek Assyrtiko or dry rosé.

timeline.what: Make or plate the dips; take the feta out of the brine.
Slice the cucumber and halve the tomatoes.
Grill the halloumi 1–2 minutes per side.
Squeeze lemon over the halloumi and serve hot.

faq.q: What goes on a Mediterranean board?
faq.a: Grilled halloumi, feta, hummus, tzatziki, dolmas, Kalamata olives, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, roasted red peppers, warm pita, dried apricots or figs and pistachios.
It has no meat. Some cheeses are made with animal rennet, so check labels if you're strictly vegetarian.
Slice it about ½ inch thick and cook in a dry nonstick pan over medium-high heat for 1 to 2 minutes a side until golden. Serve right away.
